title: Wide Field Imager view of a Milky Way look-alike, NGC 6744
displayModel: The photograph's light is decomposed into a midplane residual and a diffuse component spread through 32 slabs with an exponential profile of 666 pc (leroy et al.'s (2021) stellar scale length, 4.8 kpc at their 9.39 Mpc (105.4″), over 7.3, Kregel et al. 2002). Depth is modelled, not measured per pixel.
coverage: Milky Way foreground stars (Gaia DR3) are removed where they show; fainter and uncatalogued stars remain.

acquisition.operation: Download the publisher Large JPEG; no crop or resample.
